stat_descriptions.name: Strength
stat_descriptions.description: Physical Mastery. Required for heavy armor, swords, axes, and maces. Does not directly increase damage.

stat_descriptions.name: Dexterity
stat_descriptions.description: Agility Mastery. Required for light armor, bows, daggers, and precision gear. Does not directly increase damage.

stat_descriptions.name: Intelligence
stat_descriptions.description: Arcane Mastery. Required for robes, staves, wands, and magical items. Does not directly increase damage.

stat_descriptions.name: Vitality
stat_descriptions.description: Life Force. Each point increases Maximum Health by 2.

stat_descriptions.name: Energy
stat_descriptions.description: Magical Capacity. Each point increases Maximum Mana (scaling from database).

stat_descriptions.name: Luck
stat_descriptions.description: Fortune. Each point increases Critical Damage by 1%.

stat_descriptions.name: Life
stat_descriptions.description: Health Points. You die when this reaches 0. Regenerates over time.

stat_descriptions.name: Mana
stat_descriptions.description: Magic Points. Consumed when casting spells and using abilities.

stat_descriptions.name: Stamina
stat_descriptions.description: Endurance. Consumed by sprinting and dodging. Regenerates quickly.

stat_descriptions.name: Weapon Damage
stat_descriptions.description: Base damage of your equipped weapon. Physical and ranged skills scale from this.

stat_descriptions.name: Weapon DPS
stat_descriptions.description: Damage per second from basic attacks. Equals Weapon Damage × Attack Speed.

stat_descriptions.name: Attack Power
stat_descriptions.description: Flat bonus damage added to all weapon-based attacks.

stat_descriptions.name: Spell Power
stat_descriptions.description: Flat bonus damage added to all spell damage.

stat_descriptions.name: Attack Speed
stat_descriptions.description: Attacks per second. Determined by weapon speed plus any bonuses.

stat_descriptions.name: Critical Chance
stat_descriptions.description: Percentage chance for attacks to deal bonus damage. Base: 5%.

stat_descriptions.name: Critical Damage
stat_descriptions.description: Damage multiplier on critical hits. Base: 150%, scales with Luck.

stat_descriptions.name: Fire Spell Damage
stat_descriptions.description: Flat bonus to Fire spell damage from equipment

stat_descriptions.name: Cold Spell Damage
stat_descriptions.description: Flat bonus to Cold/Frost spell damage from equipment.

stat_descriptions.name: Lightning Spell Damage
stat_descriptions.description: Flat bonus to Lightning spell damage from equipment.

stat_descriptions.name: Poison Spell Damage
stat_descriptions.description: Flat bonus to Poison spell damage from equipment.

stat_descriptions.name: Arcane Spell Damage
stat_descriptions.description: Flat bonus to Arcane spell damage from equipment

stat_descriptions.name: Armor
stat_descriptions.description: Reduces incoming physical damage from attacks.

stat_descriptions.name: Magic Resistance
stat_descriptions.description: Reduces incoming damage from spells and elemental sources.

stat_descriptions.name: Dodge Chance
stat_descriptions.description: Percentage chance to completely evade an attack.

stat_descriptions.name: Movement Speed
stat_descriptions.description: Percentage bonus to movement velocity.

stat_descriptions.name: Life Regen
stat_descriptions.description: Health recovered per second. Base: 1/s.

stat_descriptions.name: Mana Regen
stat_descriptions.description: Mana recovered per second. Base: 0.5/s.

stat_descriptions.name: Stamina Regen
stat_descriptions.description: Stamina recovered per second. Base: 10/s.
